This week's activity for JAF0209, a Director in the ResearchAndEngineering_Government_Foreign functional unit, triggered two detection rules. The first rule was triggered due to an unusual volume of logons outside the user's working hours. Specifically, there were 8 logons during non-working hours, which is significantly higher than their typical range of 2-6 logons (z=3.48). This suggests that JAF0209 may have been working outside normal business hours.

The second rule was triggered due to an overall activity volume far outside the same-role peer distribution. In this case, there were a total of 1330 web requests, which is more than twice their typical range (950-1140) and also significantly higher than what same-role peers reported this week (760). This suggests that JAF0209's activities may be more intense or varied compared to their colleagues.
